\section{Method}
The score is \mymac{} computed as
\begin{equation}
\alpha_{ij} = \softmax_j\left(\frac{q_i^\top k_j}{\sqrt{d}}\right)
\end{equation}
\subsection{Complexity}
It costs $O(n \log n)$ instead of $O(n^2)$ \cite{vaswani2017,child2019}, i.e. 50\% fewer FLOPs.
